note: Unitree's pretrained H1 locomotion policy (TorchScript LSTM actor) from unitree_rl_gym, used by the humanoidbench backend as the walking controller under `robo act` (read without torch by src/robouse/backends/humanoidbench_worker.py). Not stored in git: the hub runtime fetches it at image build (every file SHA-256 checked); for local runs put h1_motion.pt in ~/.cache/robouse/humanoidbench/ (docs/suites/humanoidbench.md).
